facts.fact: The Prime Minister's Decree n° 22/07 of 2 March 2022 creates the Fichier Général de la Population (FGP), run by ONIP, with a national identification number and biometric data, as a decree alone; its legal bases cite no identity law, only the 2011 decree setting up ONIP and a 1923 decree-law requiring residents to be recorded.
facts.system: Fichier Général de la Population (FGP), Décret n° 22/07 du 2 mars 2022

systems.owner: Office National d'Identification de la Population (ONIP)

note: No cover fact: the instrument is a decree, not a law in force, so the digital and applied tests are not met on this document.
